messages:
elaine: FYI embeddings in eu-west1 spiking 503s for prefix-heavy requests. root cause: new batch fallback race that drains kv-cache unexpectedly. i prepared a minimal hotfix that reverts the fallback and reduces kv-cache ttl. can we fast-track canary + prod in the next 30m?

deploy-bot: @elaine created hotfix branch hotfix/revert-fallback -> build 786. CI passed, integration running (ETA ~3m). https://ci.internal/786
jordan: does this change alter embeddings outputs? need to know for release notes and to decide sampling for regression checks.

elaine: no semantic change to embeddings. tests against canonical sample set show bit-identical outputs. only runtime gating and cache TTL changed.

ops-bot: expedited-deploy flow triggered: policy requires 2 approvals from on-call leads or SRE. Canary shadowing enabled.

sam: i can +1 and will stay pinned to the incident channel for the rollout. propose strict rollback: if 5xx >0.5% in canary for any 10-min window -> immediate rollback.
jordan: +1 from me. i'll watch p99/p95 and kv-cache miss rate. starting traces dashboard. :thumbsup:

morgan: creating release note stub now and adding a public blurb for status page: "Hotfix deploy to reduce 503s for embeddings in EU; no data change expected."

elaine: plan: canary 5% eu-west1 -> 15m observation -> if stable promote to 100% with 10m watch. rollback commands: `/deploy rollback 786 --to-tag v1.2.3` or emergency `/deploy terminate 786`. patch will be pinned as v1.2.4-hotfix.
deploy-bot: preflight OK. security scan passed. canary infra allocated. rollout id 786-canary. artifact: s3://releases/786/v1.2.4-hotfix.tar.gz

ops-bot: monitors set: alert on 5xx spike, p99 latency increase, kv-cache miss surge. alert targets: #incidents and on-call pager.
jordan: 3m sample post-deploy: 503s down to 0.15% (was ~2.1%). p99 steady.
sam: holding for full 15m. no new errors from my side.

morgan: release notes updated with affected endpoints, customer-facing blurb, and rollback criteria. link: https://notes/release/v1.2.4-hotfix

elaine: if 15m stays green i'll promote to prod. posting promote when ready. :rocket:
